title: TikTok Shop Seller Center: Login, US Sign-Up, and Dashboard Guide
summary: Find the right TikTok Shop Seller Center login, complete US seller sign-up, and understand the dashboard, app, and how it compares to Shopee Seller Center.
body_markdown:
## Troubleshooting, Enforcement, and Growing Beyond Setup


Once your shop is active, account health and reliable order processing deserve regular attention. Treat login errors, verification delays, sync failures, and policy notices as separate issues: identify where the process stopped, preserve the relevant records, and follow the official support or appeal route shown in Seller Center. Platform procedures can change, so check TikTok’s current Help Center guidance before acting on older instructions.


### Fixing Login Failures, Verification Rejections, and Shopify Sync Errors


For a login failure, confirm that you are using the correct shop account and region, then review the exact error before attempting another sign-in. For a verification rejection, compare the submitted name, address, account type, and document images with the original records. If Shopify orders fail to sync, check the connection status, product mapping, inventory settings, and order timestamps in both systems. Record the affected order IDs and error messages before contacting support.


- Save screenshots of the error and note when it occurred.
- Check account notices and connection settings before resubmitting information.
- Keep order records and support correspondence together until the issue is resolved.


### Violation Points and Appeals: What Sellers Report and How to Respond


Some sellers reviewing the Seller app describe deductions they believe were unclear and an appeal process they found difficult to navigate. App Store reviews are individual reports, not a complete account of enforcement policy. If you receive a violation, read the notice for the policy cited, deadline, and appeal instructions. Submit a concise response with relevant order details, product records, or other documentation requested in the official workflow. Keep a copy of the notice and appeal submission, and monitor the account for a decision or follow-up request.
